[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-cc[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Exact code-block copy from Bob Refs, and Command-Y in Highlights[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]While reading a bob-rendered reference in Highlights, Command-Y C [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Return puts the code block on the current page on the clipboard [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]byte for byte (tabs, indentation, long lines, Mermaid source). The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]original Markdown of every new reference is preserved in the vault,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one key (M) away, and `bob ref code` gives agents and the CLI the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same data.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keep bob's note walkers out of .bob[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]walkers[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]walkers: add .bob to the always-excluded note directories so task [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]archive, link repair, project scans, and gkeep/articles walkers can [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never read or edit a saved source, with regression tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Render-time code catalog on both pandoc routes[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]catalog[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]catalog: add the two-pass code-catalog Lua filter, invisible per-block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]PDF anchors, --preserve-tabs with filter-side tab expansion, the frozen [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render input, and the promoted /Dests reader, so every Markdown and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot render returns an exact CodeCatalog with pages while the PDF [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stays unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Write-once source store and the source_markdown pointer[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]store[dim] · [dim][/dim]after walkers, catalog[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]store: persist source.md plus code.json under .bob/ref-sources at create[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]time, record the source_markdown pointer through every intake path, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]include the store in the ingest commit, warn when the catalog is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gitignored, allow it in athena's vault .gitignore, and expose the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pointer on RefRow.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob ref code read surface[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]code-cmd[dim] · [dim][/dim]after store[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]code-cmd: add the read-only bob ref code command (human, json, markdown,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]raw, page filter, saved source) with its versioned JSON contract, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-computed summaries and fenced forms, help, completion, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Overwrite repointing and the doctor sources check[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lifecycle[dim] · [dim][/dim]after store[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lifecycle: make -f overwrite stage, install, repoint, and roll back the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store inside its transaction, and add a bob ref doctor ref-sources row [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for dangling pointers, digest mismatches, orphans, and an ignored [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]catalog.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verified attach of existing references' sources[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]attach[dim] · [dim][/dim]after store, code-cmd[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]attach: add bob ref attach-source, which finds same-stem Markdown [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]candidates, verifies them against the library PDF text, and attaches [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]only verified sources; then dry-run and run it on athena per the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]backfill decision.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command-Y takeover in Highlights and type-ahead[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-key[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-key: register Command-Y as a Highlights takeover that opens the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Command-T session with the Copy card on the focused PDF, buffer keys [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]typed before the card exists, and queue card keys behind a pending load [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]so fast gestures always do what was typed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]RefsCore code catalog, C and M rows, and the code picker model[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]after code-cmd, mac-key[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-core: decode source_markdown and the bob ref code JSON, add the C [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and M rows with their hidden reasons, the pure RefsCodePicker with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]page-aware initial selection, the preview-well model, and a shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sectioned window, all unit-tested in RefsCore.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Code picker, preview well, and panel wiring[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-ui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-ui: fetch the catalog when the card opens, draw the C and M rows, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the code picker, and the fixed-height preview well in light and dark, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add HUD strings, VoiceOver, design fixtures, and docs, and verify the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Command-Y C Return gesture on the Mac.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision records[/bold #D7AFFF]                                             [bold black on #5FD7AF] xsmall [/bold black on #5FD7AF]
    [#AF87FF]records[dim] · [dim][/dim]after lifecycle, mac-ui[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records: author the two decisions-web records for the write-once source [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store and the render-time code catalog, citing the landed commits and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the research report.[/#D7D7AF]
